title: 6.6 WEATHER DERIVATIVES
summary: The chapter introduces heating and cooling degree days (HDD/CDD) as the standard temperature-deviation measures underlying weather derivatives, then works through a concrete example showing how those measures translate into a payoff for an HDD contract. Together the two pieces move from defining the index to demonstrating its mechanical application in pricing a contract's outcome.
provenance: rewritten orientation from this chapter's concept set; no new claims
